## 1. What you have actually been told

| Received | From / channel | Exact substance | Reliability / what it establishes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {{date and time}} | {{agent, GM, coach, league notice or media report}} | {{what that source communicated}} | {{report / confirmed talks / formal notice; evidence link}} |
| {{date and time}} | {{second source, only if received}} | {{new information, including any correction}} | {{what this adds without overstating it}} |

**The club's stated reason:** {{attributed explanation; Not communicated if absent}}.

**What remains unknown:** {{destination, package, approval, physical, role or other material gap}}.

**Your first reaction, if you want it recorded:** {{optional private player statement, audience and date}}.

Public reporting can precede a direct call. Preserve that sequence without inventing a GM motive or the player's response. Do not send a public statement or message for the player without their instruction.

### Show the correct state

Use the active row to determine the headline, available controls and next checkpoint; hide other states in a live screen.

| State | Player-facing meaning | Available response | What cannot be shown as completed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rumor | A report exists; club decision unverified | Ask representative to verify; record preference privately | A move, new role, reporting order or transferred contract |
| Discussions confirmed | Authorized source confirms talks | Ask what is known; communicate a preference or concern | Agreement or approval |
| Agreement pending | Clubs have agreed subject to listed requirements | Clarify conditions and logistics; make a required rights decision if verified | Effective roster transfer while a condition remains open |
| Approved, effective | Recorded requirements are met and effective date is verified | Confirm reporting, request role meeting, resolve contract questions | Any uncommunicated role promise or new contract |
| Rescinded | A dated source says the transaction will not take effect | Confirm current club, instructions and next contact | A completed transfer or deletion of the earlier notices |

**Changed since the last notice:** {{status or terms delta; link to prior notice}}. A correction supersedes the earlier claim and retains its history.

## 3. Do you have a decision right?

| Rights check | Verified result / basis | What it means for this screen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contract assignment or draft-rights transfer? | {{signed contract / unsigned rights; dated record}} | {{salary assignment or changed negotiating-rights holder}} |
| Contractual no-trade clause? | {{yes / no / unresolved; exact provision and applicable era}} | {{consent control only if it applies to this transaction}} |
| Other agreement-based consent protection? | {{verified applicable protection or None; exact rule}} | {{scope and consequences of consent}} |
| New contract involved? | {{ordinary assignment / sign-and-trade / extension-and-trade}} | {{separate eligible negotiation and execution if applicable}} |
| Other trade restrictions? | {{verified restriction or None; earliest permitted date}} | {{transaction gate, not automatically a waivable player right}} |
| Representative's review | {{name/role; checked date; evidence}} | {{cleared or precise unresolved question}} |

**Control on this page:** {{notification and transition / consent required / rights unresolved / transaction barred}}.

An ordinary assignment with no applicable consent right does not ask “Accept trade?” A request, objection or preferred destination can be communicated and logged; it does not reverse the club's decision. An unresolved rights check blocks any claim that consent is unnecessary or already given.

For 2003, distinguish a consent right from an outright trade restriction. In particular, the 1999 agreement's one-year Bird/Early Bird restriction must not be replaced by a modern consent-and-rights-loss branch. Use the [era-specific source ledger](player_experience_research.md) and exact contract.

### Consent branch, only when an applicable right is verified

| You are being asked to decide | {{precise proposal and scope of requested consent}} |
| --- | --- |
| Terms reviewed | {{transaction version; destination; contract and associated documents}} |
| Rights affected | {{what remains, what is waived, whether waiver is transaction-specific}} |
| Deadline | {{verified date, time, timezone and source; Not supplied if absent}} |
| If you consent | {{direct legal/contract effect; remaining approval conditions}} |
| If you withhold consent | {{this transaction cannot proceed on these terms; other verified consequences}} |
| Available reply | {{consent / withhold / request clarification; silence is not consent}} |

For a sign-and-trade, open the [contract desk](contract_negotiation.md) for the player's new-contract decision and separately show transaction conditions. Interest in the destination is not execution of a contract. A preview never executes either action.

A trade does not automatically create a new contract, increase pay, establish a starting job or reset statistical history. Draft-rights transfers do not invent a signed salary.

## 6. Your first 72 hours: transition planner

This planning view runs from the verified notice/effective event. It is not a league-imposed 72-hour reporting rule. Replace relative windows with confirmed local dates and times; actual reporting obligations control. For a 2003 event, verify the notice against the applicable 1999 Uniform Player Contract reporting rule and any longer period actually granted.

| Window / actual appointment | What needs to happen | Who owns it | Status / blocker |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Notice received / {{timestamp}} | Verify status, rights and current club instructions | Representative + club contact | {{confirmed / awaiting / blocked}} |
| Before travel / {{confirmed time}} | Reporting location, itinerary, moving/travel support and arrival contact | Team operations; player confirms practical needs | {{details; no invented booking}} |
| Before first activity / {{confirmed time}} | Receiving staff review of availability and recorded conditions | Qualified medical/performance staff | {{clearance status or pending}} |
| First agreed day / {{confirmed time}} | Housing, family arrangements, belongings and equipment | Team support + player | {{request and owner}} |
| First basketball meeting / {{confirmed time}} | Role, terminology and immediate preparation | Coach + player | {{assigned / requested / pending}} |
| First follow-up, ideally within 72 hours / {{agreed time}} | Check unresolved items and revise next three days | Representative + player + relevant staff | {{remaining actions}} |

**Actual reporting obligation:** {{notice received; contractual rule; due date/time/timezone; location; source}}.

**Conflict with your calendar:** {{training, negotiation, travel or personal commitment}}. **Agreed change:** {{who changed what and when}}.

**Practical information needed:** {{minimum needed for the logistics; sensitive addresses/family details stay outside a public notice}}.
